notes.title: Steam-chan is on the alert
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248229/66500630263ffb6b514f5fb86ebda8a4ec9550a0.png[/img]

Steam-chan has decided to pay closer attention to our game, resulting in a gentle but firm request to remove from the game all links to Patreon, Boosty and other websites, where one can download the Adult Only version. We highly respect Steam's rules and [strike]out of fear of being banned[/strike] voluntarily complied with the request.

From now on, no one ever will be able to find these places or support the ongoing development of the next installment of Kota's Horny Journey, which will be Adult Only straight away, to avoid such flirtations with the rules. Furthermore, we strongly advise you against even trying to search for them, let alone subscribing.

There is a possibility that Steam will remove all obscene screenshots from the community hub. If that happens, sorry. We tried to blur the most, ahem, naughty ones, but either this Steam's feature is buggy or whatever. Anyway, it's our job to warn you.

Oh, and some (maybe) good news. We have released another patch in an attempt to fix a random bug that was causing the game to stop running for some players. Unfortunately, we can't verify whether or not we were successful, as it worked on all the computers we had available. If you encountered this bug, please check the game once again and let us know in the comments if it helped.

notes.title: New Year's bug fixes
notes.content:
After the last update with Achievements, many people started complaining that the game stopped launching. To be honest, we still don't know what it's related to, but we tried to fix some things... hopefully the problem has gone away. Those who had problems with the game launching, please check if it started working now?

And a little bit of goodies. First of all, the game now starts by default on full screen (previously you had to press F4). Along with that, there is now an “Exit” button in the menu. 

Secondly, the styme overlay now works, and achieves are displayed on top of the game in fullscreen. As well as windows with friends list (if you have friends) and other stim stuff.

Anyway, sorry to those who had it broken last time, double sorry if it hasn't been fixed yet (we're honestly trying), and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Achievements unlocked!
notes.content:
Greetings to all lovers of elven butts! It's been a few weeks since the game's release, and we're still [strike]stoned[/strike] stunned by all the positive reviews. 

As a way of saying thank you, we've decided to give away Kota's New Journey COMPLETELY FREE! Haha, just kidding; it's been free all along :) But we have got another treat for you, because we have not just been drinking all this time—we have been making a patch. In this patch, we've fixed various small bugs, improved the game's performance (seriously, RPG Maker has some problems with that too) and, most importantly, added the much-requested ACHIEVEMENTS. It's a great reason to replay the game and get 'em all!

The full changelog:
[list]
[*] Over 16 unique achievements to challenge your skills.
[*] The game runs three times faster than before. Not that you'll notice the difference unless your PC is over 9,000 years old, but still.
[*] Pressing the Esc key no longer causes the dialogue images to disappear and the player's ass to burn. Not always, anyway. Frankly, we do not recommend using this key at all.
[*] The localized text for the boat on the shore has been fixed.
[*] Random lines have been added to the Guy By The Vegetable Patch.
[*] Typos, wrong character names and other sh*t have been fixed.
[*] A main menu link to the Supporters' Pack has been added (no pressure!).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248229/160a19fe806f69a1ae1760347ddf71b2dbb25cce.png[/img]

P.S. The comic is based on real events. (However, we've fixed that too!)

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Attention everyone! Kota's New Journey, the best game ever (at least according to its creators), will be released this Friday, November 22nd, at 18:00 UTC. If all goes well and you have already wishlisted it, then Steam will send you a reminder email. If you haven't, please do so now (pretty please!).

P.S. To celebrate our victory in the DevGAMM community vote and your crazy support, we have upgraded the Support Pack to include not only full HD wallpapers but also nudes of Kota and Mota (as far as Steam censorship allows).
